project_type: FastAPI backend (Python) + Vite/React/TypeScript frontend (web), single-user monorepo
build_system: backend: uvicorn + alembic migrations (manual, not autogenerate); frontend: Vite + tsc (npm run build). No monorepo runner — each runs independently.
test_framework: backend: pytest (pytest>=8.3 in requirements.txt). No frontend test framework configured.
build_command: frontend: cd frontend/web && npm run build   |   backend: no separate compile step; python -c 'from app.main import app' validates imports
verification_instructions: 1) Backend import check: cd backend && python -c 'from app.main import app; print("OK")'. 2) Frontend build: cd frontend/web && npm run build (must exit 0 with no TS errors). 3) Run pytest: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v (new tests must pass). 4) For ML modules: python -c 'from app.ml.<module> import <symbol>; print("OK")'.
snapshot_or_generated_files: backend/app/ml/artifacts/*.pt (PyTorch checkpoints) — NOT committed. Alembic migration files in backend/alembic/versions/ ARE committed and must be written manually.
environment_constraints: Windows dev machine (PowerShell). Do NOT run alembic upgrade head (DB may not be reachable). Write migration files manually. recharts is NOT installed — use plain HTML for charts. No concurrent worktree processes.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing SQLAlchemy patterns (Mapped, mapped_column, TypeDecorator for JSON). Follow existing Pydantic v2 patterns (BaseModel, Field). Migration files: manually written, following ab73d9e1c540_add_recommendation_feedback.py exactly. All ML files: optional torch import with _TORCH_AVAILABLE guard.
key_patterns: 1) SQLAlchemy models: use Mapped[T] = mapped_column(...) syntax, Base from app.db.base, UUID as Uuid(as_uuid=True). 2) JSON columns: TypeDecorator with impl=Text, cache_ok=True — see JSONUUIDList in outfit.py. 3) Routes: APIRouter with prefix and tags, auth via Depends(get_current_user), db via Depends(get_db). 4) Schemas: Pydantic BaseModel with class Config: from_attributes=True for ORM reads. 5) ML modules: try/except torch import at top, _TORCH_AVAILABLE flag, graceful stubs. 6) Alembic: op.create_table / op.drop_table in upgrade/downgrade, sa.Column with exact types.
directory_structure: backend/app/models/ — SQLAlchemy ORM models; backend/app/schemas/ — Pydantic request/response schemas; backend/app/api/routes/ — FastAPI routers (registered in __init__.py then included in main.py via api_router); backend/app/ml/ — ML models and training utilities; backend/app/ml/artifacts/ — PyTorch checkpoint files (.pt); backend/app/agents/ — agent orchestration; backend/alembic/versions/ — migration files; frontend/web/src/ — React app (App.tsx is monolithic, api.ts is the API client).
